name: read
description: Read a file from the local filesystem. file_path must be absolute. By default reads up to 2000 lines from the start; use offset (1-indexed line number) and limit (lines to read) for large files. For PDFs >10 pages, pages is required (e.g. '1-5'). Output is cat -n style with line numbers. Reads text, images (visible to vision models), PDFs, and Jupyter notebooks. Cannot read directories.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: Required absolute path to the file.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Optional 1-indexed line number to start reading from. Use only when the file is too large to read at once.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Optional number of lines to read. Use only when the file is too large to read at once. Defaults to a framework-chosen value (~2000).

inputs.name: pages
inputs.description: Optional page range for PDFs (e.g. '1-5', '3', '10-20'). Required for PDFs longer than 10 pages. Maximum 20 pages per request.
